review:
Probably the smallest cluster game around: nine six-sided cubes on a 3x3 grid, each showing one of six colours. Match the colours to win.

Before you play, pick low, medium or high risk – higher risk needs a bigger cluster (three, four or five blocks) but pays bigger multipliers, and you can see every payout under the panel before you spin. It's more mini-game than slot, and very transparent. 5,000x top prize and a 98% RTP.
